admin_auth.guard_evidence: config/admin.php:130-152 (guard at :135); merged into auth config by vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/AdminServiceProvider.php:185
admin_auth.auth_middleware_behaviour: Dcat\Admin\Http\Middleware\Authenticate returns admin_redirect(auth/login, 401) for guests unless path is in admin.auth.except (vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/Http/Middleware/Authenticate.php:19-30); except list = auth/login, auth/logout (config/admin.php:156-159).

permission_layer.behaviour: Dcat\Admin\Http\Middleware\Permission passes through when no user, args given, permission disabled, path excepted, user->isAdministrator(), or a route-level admin.permission:* middleware ran; otherwise requires a matching permission or Checker::error() (vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/Http/Middleware/Permission.php:27-49).

admin_auth.forced_password_change: App\Http\Middleware\ForceAdminPasswordChange flags sessions whose admin password still verifies against the literal "admin" and redirects everything except auth/setting, auth/logout, auth/login (app/Http/Middleware/ForceAdminPasswordChange.php:12-46).
admin_auth.login_rate_limit: 5 attempts / 60s per lowercased username + IP, RateLimiter (app/Admin/Controllers/AuthController.php:17-25); password minimum 10 chars on change (:51-55) and "admin" rejected (:57-61).
admin_auth.admin_route_owner: All 89 Dcat routes plus 6 App\Admin routes are under the same guard; admin user with isAdministrator() bypasses permission checks — a single admin-account compromise yields full admin surface.

csrf.encrypt_cookies: All cookies encrypted: EncryptCookies::$except is empty (app/Http/Middleware/EncryptCookies.php:14-16); dujiaoka_orders order-list cookie therefore cannot be forged without APP_KEY.
notes: CSRF protection is inherited by every web-group route, including /admin; only pay/*/notify_url and pay/*/return_url are exempt.

install_flow.gate: App\Http\Middleware\InstallCheck redirects to / when install.lock exists (app/Http/Middleware/InstallCheck.php:20-22); symmetric gate in DujiaoBoot redirects to /install when absent (app/Http/Middleware/DujiaoBoot.php:20-23).
install_flow.state_effects: do-install validates inputs, writes .env (generates APP_KEY), imports database/sql/install.sql, sets admin username/password (bcrypt), writes install.lock (app/Http/Controllers/Home/HomeController.php:132-228).
install_flow.risk_note: On a fresh deployment before install.lock exists, any network client can re-run installation and overwrite .env / admin credentials; the only protection is the file lock and CSRF token.
